canonical.idPolicy: Harness-assigned opaque 8-character IDs: collision-checked deterministic SHA256/base64url prefixes map EACH WHOLE generated structured bunch ID bijectively. Counters, run grouping, operation order, anchors and characters are identical to the structured replay. Not recorded collaborator identities; no refresh or regrouping.

upstreamVerification.method: Local operation/text digests match pinned upstream JSON-literal comparison

interpretation: Explicit1xCPU; fresh contexts in one browser process, not separate browser processes.
Load samples are warm replacement construction, excluding JSON.parse; load CPU profiles include parsing.
Canonical CPU profiles include post-clock validation; diagnostic only.
Remote sessions omit at, anchor checks, and ID-object creation; not a pure at-time subtraction.
Local lookup is first20000positions sequentially, not cursor-local.
Heap deltas include post-warmup runtime/JIT growth, not exclusively list bytes.
All existing-tree variants use the same thin runtime wrapper; native variants use direct calls.
Three case rotations do not fully counterbalance all candidates; report ranges, not significance.
methodology: Library-only Chromium. Same decoded F01 input; native conversion charged in load. 20 warm loads after one warmup per fresh context. Replay clock includes anchor validation and optional last-100 ID-version retention, not final full-state/history verification. Full canonical stream is uninterrupted, 259778 operations; loaded sessions are2000. Lookup pairs=at+indexOf, not separate operations. Forced GC before/after tests, never inside timed replay. Memory=heap+backing relative to empty warmed context; input JSON text retained in baseline, decoded run objects released. CPU profiles are separate diagnostic runs, never mixed into unprofiled timing. No editor/rendering, network or Mongo metrics.
